neighbours.label: the closing token of a fixed multi-word name or term, where the earlier words already predict it (Soviet Union, Institute of Technology, compulsive disorder), as opposed to the same word used on its own
fire: She earned her doctorate at the Georgia Institute of Technology before moving to Seattle.
Grain exports to the Soviet Union fell sharply after the embargo.
The Federal Aviation Administration grounded the fleet for a week.
Doctors diagnosed the boy with obsessive-compulsive disorder when he was nine.
Delegates from the African Union arrived in Addis Ababa on Monday.
Immigrants to the United States often settled first in port cities.
Many pilots trained at the California Institute of Technology during the war.
The clinic treats adults with attention deficit disorder on weekday evenings.
quiet: She earned her doctorate in the history of technology before moving to Seattle.
Grain exports fell sharply after the union called a strike.
The new administration grounded the plan for a week.
Doctors saw signs of disorder in the boy's room when he was nine.
Delegates from the dockers' union arrived at the harbour on Monday.
Immigrants in several states often settled first in port cities.
Many pilots trained with new technology and simulators during the war.
The clinic treats adults with a sleep problem on weekday evenings.

short: closing word of a fixed multi-word name
notes: Card: ' States' x8, ' Technology' x4, ' Union' x3, 'is' of Caenorhabditis, 'amphetamine'. Probes: Institute of Technology 0.55, European Union 0.55, Drug Administration 0.46, stress disorder 0.39, United States 0.38, methamphetamine 0.97; the same words standing alone 0.01-0.03. Pole-side weaker: Pennsylvania 0.19, aureus 0.12, so it is not every name.
